netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_B2 0 B2_am 0
V_B2 B2_int n2 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B2_in B2_am B2_int 0.1
vam_SIG1 n3 SIG1_am 0
V_SIG1 SIG1_int 0 SIN(0 3 1000)
R_SIG1_in SIG1_am SIG1_int 0.1
vam_C1 n3 C1_am 0
C_C1 C1_am n4 1e-05
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n4 1000
vam_D1 n4 D1_am 0
D_D1 D1_am n5 1N4148
vam_D2 n5 D2_am 0
D_D2 D2_am n6 1N4148
vam_R2 n6 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am n2 1000
vam_Q1 n1 Q1_am 0
vam_Q1_p0 n4 Q1_p0 0
vam_Q1_p2 n7 Q1_p2 0
Q_Q1 Q1_am Q1_p0 Q1_p2 2N3904
vam_Q2 n2 Q2_am 0
vam_Q2_p0 n6 Q2_p0 0
vam_Q2_p2 n7 Q2_p2 0
Q_Q2 Q2_am Q2_p0 Q2_p2 2N3906
vam_R3 n7 R3_am 0
R_R3 R3_am 0 100
.model 1N4148 D(IS=4.352n N=1.906 BV=110 IBV=0.0001 RS=0.6458 CJO=7.048p VJ=0.869 M=0.03 FC=0.5 TT=3.48n)
.model 2N3904 NPN(IS=6.734f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=74.03 BF=416.4 NE=1.259 ISE=6.734f IKF=66.78m XTB=1.5 BR=.7371 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=1 CJC=3.638p MJC=.3085 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=4.493p MJE=.2593 VJE=.75 TR=239.5n TF=301.2p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=2 RB=10)
.model 2N3906 PNP(IS=1.41f XTI=3 EG=1.11 VAF=18.7 BF=180.7 NE=1.5 ISE=0 IKF=80m XTB=1.5 BR=4.977 NC=2 ISC=0 IKR=0 RC=2.5 CJC=9.728p MJC=.5776 VJC=.75 FC=.5 CJE=8.063p MJE=.3677 VJE=.75 TR=33.42n TF=179.3p ITF=.4 VTF=4 XTF=6 RB=10)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 5e-06 0.005 0 5e-06
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) v(n4) v(n5) v(n6) v(n7) i(vam_b1) i(vam_b2) i(vam_sig1) i(vam_c1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_d1) i(vam_d2) i(vam_r2) i(vam_q1) i(vam_q2) i(vam_r3) i(vam_q1_p0) i(vam_q1_p2) i(vam_q2_p0) i(vam_q2_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
